source.kind: Specification-derived fixtures, not a traffic capture
source.framing: Section B: little-endian magic 0x2e64616d, data length, CRC32 of the first eight bytes. Section D: packed command fields.
source.stop: The complete command body is transcribed byte-for-byte from section D's literal example. Only the section B envelope is added.
source.hello: Section F's exact three-property example, joined by UTF-16LE tabs. Empty component and zero instance identify the process hello from section E. Process/module identifiers are reused from D; command number starts at 1.
source.confirm: Section E specifies confirm with no parameters. This is the next process-level message, command number 2, with the same process/module identifiers. Section C makes the higher-IP peer the master.
source.generation: Transcribed using Python's struct and zlib only; DisplayCAL's serializer and parser were not used to construct these bytes.
